title: Mystic Voyage to Enchanted Castle
description: A surreal fantasy seascape features three glowing pink sailboats with elven figures navigating waters covered in swirling golden ripples. In the foreground a woman in blue kneels on a stone path beside a glowing blue lantern, while a dark castle with a flaming stag-horned tower stands on the right with robed figures. The swirling purple and blue sky contains four glowing celestial orbs with fire, flowers, and a lotus.
